verses.en: LORD, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.
verses.pt: Ó Senhor, a ti clamo; dá-te pressa em me acudir! Dá ouvidos à minha voz, quando a ti clamo!
verses.en_web: Yahweh, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.
verses.en_bbe: <A Psalm. Of David.> Lord, I have made my cry to you; come to me quickly; give ear to my voice, when it goes up to you.

verses.en: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
verses.pt: Suba a minha oração, como incenso, diante de ti, e seja o levantar das minhas mãos como o sacrifício da tarde!
verses.en_web: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.
verses.en_bbe: Let my prayer be ordered before you like a sweet smell; and let the lifting up of my hands be like the evening offering.

verses.en: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
verses.pt: Põe, ó Senhor, uma guarda à minha boca; vigia a porta dos meus lábios!
verses.en_web: Set a watch, Yahweh, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, keep a watch over my mouth; keep the door of my lips.

verses.en: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.
verses.pt: Não inclines o meu coração para o mal, nem para se ocupar de coisas más, com aqueles que praticam a iniqüidade; e não coma eu das suas gulodices!
verses.en_web: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.
verses.en_bbe: Keep my heart from desiring any evil thing, or from taking part in the sins of the evil-doers with men who do wrong: and let me have no part in their good things.

verses.en: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.
verses.pt: Fira-me o justo, será isso uma benignidade; e repreenda-me, isso será como óleo sobre a minha cabeça; não o recuse a minha cabeça; mas continuarei a orar contra os feitos dos ímpios.
verses.en_web: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.
verses.en_bbe: Let the upright give me punishment; and let the god-fearing man put me in the right way; but I will not let the oil of sinners come on my head: when they do evil I will give myself to prayer.

verses.en: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
verses.pt: Quando os seus juízes forem arremessados duma penha abaixo, saberão que as palavras do Senhor são verdadeiras.
verses.en_web: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.
verses.en_bbe: When destruction comes to their judges by the side of the rock, they will give ear to my words, for they are sweet.

verses.en: Our bones are scattered at the grave’s mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.
verses.pt: Como quando alguém lavra e sulca a terra, são os nossos ossos espalhados à boca do Seol.
verses.en_web: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”
verses.en_bbe: Our bones are broken up at the mouth of the underworld, as the earth is broken by the plough.

verses.en: But mine eyes are unto thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.
verses.pt: Mas os meus olhos te contemplam, ó Senhor, meu Senhor; em ti tenho buscado refúgio; não me deixes sem defesa!
verses.en_web: For my eyes are on you, Yahweh, the Lord. In you, I take refuge. Don’t leave my soul destitute.
verses.en_bbe: But my eyes are turned to you, O Lord God: my hope is in you; let not my soul be given up to death.

verses.en: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.
verses.pt: Guarda-me do laço que me armaram, e das armadilhas dos que praticam a iniqüidade.
verses.en_web: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.
verses.en_bbe: Keep me from the net which they have put down for me, and from the designs of the workers of evil.

verses.en: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.
verses.pt: Caiam os ímpios nas suas próprias redes, até que eu tenha escapado inteiramente.
verses.en_web: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets, while I pass by.
verses.en_bbe: Let the sinners be taken in the nets which they themselves have put down, while I go free.
